records.rationale: A repository-wide exact-token search for `SubscribeConfig` found occurrences only in crates/google-workspace-cli/src/helpers/events/subscribe.rs: the declaration itself (line 8, excluded as the query token) and three type references at 0-based lines 31, 82, and 381, all resolving to the struct via same-module scope. All other matches are the distinct derive-generated identifier `SubscribeConfigBuilder` (substring, not an exact-name token, omitted per rule 3). events/mod.rs declares `pub mod subscribe;` but contains no import or re-export binding token for `SubscribeConfig`, and the test module's `use super::*;` is an implicit wildcard with no identifier token, so no optional binding locations exist. All lines are ASCII, so UTF-16 columns equal character indexes. definitionUsage is the first required location after sorting by URI, start line, then start character.
